subject: [PATCH v8 00/14] mm: thp: always enable mTHP support

reviews.author: Luiz Capitulino
reviews.summary: Reviewer Luiz Capitulino noted that the patch's removal of a guard in start_stop_khugepaged() can lead to an idle khugepaged thread being started unnecessarily, raising min_free_kbytes, and suggested replacing hugepage_enabled()'s check for global configuration with a check for enabled orders after masking PMD_ORDER when pgtable_has_pmd_leaves() is false.
reviews.raw_body:
You're right about the issue. Before this series, checking the global
configuration was sufficient to determine if THP was "enabled" as PMD
leaves would always be available (otherwise THP would be shut down).
With this series, we also need to check pgtable_has_pmd_leaves().

I prefer the simple fix below over masking orders in hugepage_enabled():
it's simple and adds the check only in the call site that requires it.

diff --git a/mm/khugepaged.c b/mm/khugepaged.c
index a3a9e4d93b46..175252a1d729 100644
--- a/mm/khugepaged.c
+++ b/mm/khugepaged.c
@@ -453,7 +453,7 @@ static bool hugepage_enabled(void)
  	 * Shmem pmd-sized hugepages are also determined by its pmd-size control,
  	 * except when the global shmem_huge is set to SHMEM_HUGE_DENY.
  	 */
-	if (hugepage_global_enabled())
+	if (hugepage_global_enabled() && pgtable_has_pmd_leaves())
  		return true;
  	if (anon_hpage_enabled())
  		return true;

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch removes a guard that prevents the start_stop_khugepaged function from running on systems without PMD leaves, allowing mTHP support to be always enabled even in such cases. This change is necessary because hugepage_enabled still returns true when the global always or madvise flag is set, which can lead to unnecessary resource allocation and increased min_free_kbytes. The patch proposes an alternative approach by testing whether an enabled order remains after masking PMD_ORDER when pgtable_has_pmd_leaves is false.
